hook.line: She wishes more people said social media marketing is more than just posting content.
hook.visual: Creator on a sofa with a handheld mic, one bold white word at a time at the top; at 1.8 s a cut to a flat yellow card typing out the claim.

beats.what: Opening claim to camera, word-by-word white caption at the top.
Cut to a full-screen yellow text card repeating the claim.
Series title 'Social Media Marketing Basics' with a yellow pill 'but nobody teaches you' over her.
Names the mistake: jumping straight to tactics.
Maroon card with 'destination' and 'journey' pills explaining goal vs strategy.
Maroon card spelling SMART with the initial letters bolded.
Orange 'STRATEGY' pill labels the section, script word 'how' under it.
Big yellow '150,000' number pops up as the example.
Maroon card with 'tactics = 3 months' pill: refresh cadence for each layer.
Handwritten 'I will see you in episode 2' sign-off over her.

why_it_works: Named series with an episode number ('episode one', 'see you in episode two') gives a reason to follow for the next part.
A three-part frame (goal, strategy, tactics) mapped to destination / route / steps makes an abstract topic easy to hold.
Full-screen flat colour cards replace her face at each new term, so each concept lands as its own visual beat.
Mild confession ('the result is content that's crap') breaks the polished tone and feels honest.
weaknesses: At 103 s with one 31.8 s shot, the middle drags on a static framing.
Opening line is a soft 'I wish' rather than a sharp promise, so the first 2 s give little reason to stay.
Captions sit in the top band and 37.6% of text falls outside the safe area.
for_robert: Use the colour-card swap: when a new term is introduced, cut from his face to a flat brand-colour card with the word in a pill, and Fred could pop in to hold the pill.
